name: Reach for the Stars
source:
After a near suicide attempt, Abby returns to her old home town in order to heal the inner wounds of her past. When arriving back to Belmont she makes quick friends with a group of girls who all appear to have what she doesn’t; true happiness. But on her way to recovery Abby will find that no one has an easy life and in order to progress past the pain they must learn to face their greatest fears and darker selves.

Can she help them? 

Will she herself be able to forget her own trouble past?

Or will she herself once again sink back into her depression?

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1803745874/reach-for-the-stars-a-yuri-visual-novel/]Kickstarter page[/url]]
translation:
在一次近乎自杀的尝试之后，艾比回到了她的故乡，以治愈她过去的内心创伤。回到贝尔蒙特后，她很快就和一群女孩成了朋友，她们似乎都拥有她所没有的东西。真正的幸福。但在康复的路上，艾比会发现没有人的生活是一帆风顺的，为了摆脱痛苦，他们必须学会面对最大的恐惧和黑暗的自我。

她能帮助他们吗？

她自己能否忘记自己过去的烦恼呢？

又或者她自己会再次陷入抑郁之中吗？

[来自[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1803745874/reach-for-the-stars-a-yuri-visual-novel/]Kickstarter页面[/url]]
